# 10. 기능 카탈로그 (Feature Catalog)

quanta-codeagent-v3에 **구현·배선된** 기능 전수 목록. **대**(주요 시스템) → **중**(하위 능력) → **소**(구체 기능/노브) 3단.

근거: RFC `rfc/0001-architecture.md`, ADR `docs/decisions/0001~0027`. cross-import는 `@/agent`만(슬라이스 격리). 운영 reference: [docs/runbooks/agent-loop-reference.md](docs/runbooks/agent-loop-reference.md).

## 성숙도 5단계 척도

있다/없다 이분이 아니라 **구현 폐쇄도(closure)** 를 5단계로:

| 등급 | 의미 |
|---|---|
| **L5 ●●●●●** | 완성·검증 — 구현·배선·단위+통합테스트, **실 LLM 스모크 또는 e2e 폐쇄** 확인됨 |
| **L4 ●●●●○** | 견고 — 구현·배선·단위+통합테스트(실 runAgent, mock LLM). 실 LLM 스모크는 미실시 |
| **L3 ●●●○○** | 동작 — 구현·배선됨, **단위테스트 위주**(통합 미검증) |
| **L2 ●●○○○** | 부분/한계 — 동작하나 **의도적 제약·advisory·옵셔널 미도달** |
| **L1 ●○○○○** | 골격/보류 — **타입/API만 노출**, 루프 미배선, 의식적 후속 |

`⚙️` = env/config 노브(기본 OFF·behavior-preserving).

> **R-Phase1-4 closure (2026-05-21)** — 2-round 코드 audit(8 parallel agents) 후 correctness + observability + 정직성 일괄 폐쇄. **P0** (HIGH): streaming-dispatch 3개소 rejection 경로(`Promise.all` → `Promise.allSettled`, drainDeferredSlots try/catch, collectResultBlocks 합성 `dispatchFailedBlock`) — ordering invariant 회복; `maybeCompact()` try-catch + `error` 이벤트 + graceful degrade; `resolveMemoryContext()` 동등 처리. **P1** (MED): proactive compaction 성공 시 `recovery:{reason:"compact",detail:"proactive"}` 방출(reactive 대칭); `stream_reset` tombstone orphan promise `.catch(()=>{})` 가드(Bun unhandledRejection 방지); jsonl-recorder degraded-line 실패에 `logger.warn` 진단; streamingTurn `AbortSignal` 계약 docstring. **P3** (defensive): CLI 진입점 `process.on("unhandledRejection")` defense-in-depth; `HookBus.on` 제너릭 cast → closure-erasure(런타임 안전 + 타입 표면 개선); `WorkingMemory.snapshot` shallow-copy 명시(`WorkingState.snapshot`의 deep-copy와 구분). **P2** 회귀 테스트 6개 파일(40 신규 테스트): `streaming-dispatch-rejection-e2e`(4), `observability-error-event-e2e`(4 — P0-2/P0-3/P1-1 검증 + default-OFF 회귀 가드), `skill-discover-errors`(11), `lsp-bridge-probe`(3 — Promise.race 5s 타임아웃 + 캐시 + extension fast-path), `mcp-client-errors`(8 — empty command + not-running), `env-knob-branches`(35 — `pickProvider`/`buildStore`/`buildMemoryConfig`/`parseRecallTiers`/`buildSubagentConfig`/`buildVerifyGuardConfig`/`buildSkillsConfig` 전 분기). 모든 변경 default-OFF byte-identical 불변식 무손상.
>
> **R-Phase5 closure (2026-05-21)** — 또 2-round 코드 audit(8 parallel agents) 추가 진행 후 7건 fix + 7 regression test. **P0** (HIGH): (A) `features.cleanup` hook이 `loop.ts finish()` 어디에도 invoke되지 않아 background subagent 자식이 부모 abort 시 orphan — 5 finish 사이트 모두 cleanup invoke + try-catch(`error` 이벤트로 surface, default-OFF 시 optional chain 무동작). (B) `cacheConversationPrefix`가 마지막 블록이 `tool_use`/`tool_result`/`thinking`일 때 `cache_control`을 비-text 블록에 부착 (Anthropic API 무시 + 일부 버전에서 reject) — backward walk으로 last text 블록을 찾아 부착, text 블록 부재 시 graceful no-op. (C) `onConfirm` 콜백이 throw할 때 admissibility-gate가 propagate(2개소: HITL always-confirm 114, mode-policy ask 149) — try-catch로 wrap, `preview:"error"` 태그된 deny로 surface. **P1** (MED): (D) `HARD_DENY rm-recursive-force-system-root` 정규식 3개 `[\s\S]*?` lookahead unbounded ReDoS 위험 → `{0,500}?` 명시 bound(real bash command well under, adversarial 10KB+ input 100ms 미만 완료). (F) anthropic adapter `thinking_delta` explicit drain(Phase-1 intent 문서화). (G) FallbackLLM이 fallback provider가 zero event yield + prior partial 존재 시 stream_reset tombstone 누락 → for-await 외부에서 명시 emit. (H) `SqliteStore.save()` INSERT 동기 throw가 `Promise<void>` boundary를 우회 → try-catch + `Promise.reject(new Error("SqliteStore.save(<id>) failed: ..."))`. **회귀 테스트 7 파일(43 tests)**: `subagent-cleanup-invocation-e2e`(3), `anthropic-cache-control-blocks`(5), `onconfirm-throw`(5 — 3개 throw path + 2개 control), `hard-deny-redos-bound`(11 — positive/negative + 10KB adversarial timing < 100ms), `anthropic-thinking-delta`(4), `fallback-empty-tombstone`(4), `sqlite-save-error`(5). 모든 변경 default-OFF byte-identical 불변식 무손상(`features.cleanup?.()` optional chain, fallback의 prior-partial gate, etc.).

> **R-Phase7 fault-localization 도구 (2026-05-21)** — Agentless 3-stage(file→function→edit-location) funnel + codex-검증 신호 도구 흡수. **3-stage 구조 (Hybrid A+C, RFC §1.2 정합 — 신규 도구 0 for funnel, micro-FSM 회피)**: (A) `prompt.ts` tool routing matrix에 "localize a fault → localize/grep → read+lsp_document_symbol → lsp_references" 한 줄 추가; (C) `src/skill/system-skills/localize-fault/SKILL.md` 신설 — Stage1 FILE / Stage2 FUNCTION / Stage3 EDIT-LOCATION + outcome enum(`located`/`narrowed`/`uncertain`) + 4-truth-surface + 신호 위계("rg locates, source proves" — source text 10/10 > rg hits 5/10). `triggerLocalizeFault`/`findLocalizeFaultSkill`/`LOCALIZE_FAULT_SKILL_NAME` wiring seam(progress-audit 미러). **신규 도구 4종 (codex signal absorption, all read-only + concurrency-safe + MUTATING_TOOL_TABLE `null`)**: (1) `file_tree_summary` — depth-bounded .gitignore-respecting 디렉터리 트리 + per-dir 파일 카운트 (Stage-1 structure; codex file-topology 7/6); (2) `parse_test_failure` — pure 파서, raw 테스트/빌드 로그 → `file:line [framework]` 추출 (pytest/python-traceback/jest/vitest/bun/go-test/cargo; Stage-3, build-log 8/9 trust); (3) `git_churn` — 변경 빈도 hotspot 랭킹 (Stage-1 recency); (4) `git_blame_heatmap` — per-author 라인 ownership 분포 (Stage-1 ownership). defaultTools에 `file_tree_summary`+`parse_test_failure` 등록(byte-identical: 미호출 세션 무변경), gitTools 6→8(`QUANTA_GIT_TOOLS` opt-in 유지). **회귀 테스트 5 파일(약 70 tests)**: `skill-localize-fault`(frontmatter+3-stage body+wiring), `file-tree-summary`(트리/depth/cap/jail), `parse-test-failure`(6 framework + dedup + reject), `git-churn-blame-heatmap`(pure rank + tool 양면), `prompt-system` routing 단언 추가. **통합 가드 수정**: `MUTATING_TOOL_TABLE`(mode.ts) 4 entry(전부 read-only `null`), git-tools barrel count 6→8 단언. 모든 변경 default-OFF byte-identical 불변식 무손상.
>
> **R-Phase7b system-skills 런타임 배선 (2026-05-21)** — localize-fault/progress-audit 스킬이 만들어졌지만 `config.skills`가 `{ dir: string }` 필수라 `QUANTA_SKILLS_DIR` 미설정 시 **루프에서 도달 불가**였던 갭 폐쇄(ADR-0045 "유저가 env var 기억 안 해도 discipline 스킬은 available" 약속 위반). 수정: (1) `AgentConfig.skills.dir`를 optional로 (`{ dir?: string; changedPaths?: string[] }`); (2) `buildSkillFeatures`가 dir 부재 시 user 스킬 discovery 스킵 + bundled system 스킬만 로드; (3) CLI `buildSkillsConfig` 3-state — `QUANTA_SKILLS_DIR=<path>`→`{dir}`(user+system), `QUANTA_SKILLS=1`/`--skills`→`{}`(system only), 둘 다 없으면 `undefined`(byte-identical OFF). 이제 `QUANTA_SKILLS=1`만으로 localize-fault+progress-audit 즉시 invocable. 스킬 ABSENT 세션은 여전히 Skill 도구 미등록(RFC §1.2 무손상). 회귀 테스트: `features.test.ts`에 `skills:{}`→bundled 양쪽 discovered + ABSENT→no Skill tool 단언, `env-knob-branches`에 3-state 분기.
>
> **R-Phase8 fault-localization 도구 품질 강화 (2026-05-21)** — R-Phase7 도구 4종 비판적 audit 후 진짜 품질 갭 4건 구조적 폐쇄. **#1 `parse_test_failure` vendored 필터 + user-code-first 랭킹** (최고 레버리지): `FrameTier`(user>test>vendored) + `classifyFrame`(node_modules/.pnp/site-packages/.venv/.cargo/vendor/dist/build/target) + TEST_FILE 휴리스틱. tier-우선 정렬(동률 시 discovery 순) + **랭킹 후 cap** → vendored flood가 user 프레임을 max_results 밖으로 못 밀어냄(codex build-log 8/9 trust). **#2 probe 3-stage funnel 측정 장치** (honesty loop): `apps/probe/funnel.ts` `observeFunnel`/`renderFunnel` + `probe --funnel` — trajectory tool_call 시퀀스에서 file→function→edit-location **monotonic** 진행 관찰, NON-authoritative(낮은 stage는 결함 아님). R-Phase7이 약속한 "probe trace 측정"을 실제 구현 → 옵션 B 승격 근거(RFC §9.1). **#3 `file_tree_summary` purpose layer**: `summarize:true` → `rg -m1` 두 번째 패스로 파일별 첫 선언/주석 추출 + ` — <hint>` 주석(200파일 cap, 80자 truncate, 실패 시 구조-only degrade). **#4 `git_blame_heatmap` line-range**: `start_line`/`end_line` → `git blame -L`로 함수 단위 ownership, zod refine으로 paired+ordered 강제. **회귀 73 tests/5 files green**. 의도적 보류: 옵션 B `localize_hierarchical`(micro-FSM, funnel 데이터 보고 결정), embedding search, AST fallback. read-only + concurrency-safe + byte-identical.
>
> **베이스라인 주의 (R-Phase7~8 시점)** — 본 단락 작성 시점 repo는 다수 외부 병렬 WIP(Wave A ReviewerPort, ADR-0030 mid-turn steering, Wave D vocabulary, apps/cli/slash-commands `process.env`)로 인해 full `bun test`에 ~58개 외부 failure가 존재(R-Phase7~8 추가와 무관 — 본 도구/스킬/배선/강화 테스트는 전부 green, MINE-related failure 0 확인 + 외부 `apply_patch` MUTATING_TOOL_TABLE 누락도 함께 수정해 공유 drift gate 회복). 따라서 `refresh-baseline.ts` 실행을 의도적으로 보류(외부 WIP failure를 baseline으로 기록하지 않기 위함). 베이스라인 수치는 외부 WIP 안정화 후 갱신 예정 — 위 R-Phase6 수치(205 files)는 R-Phase7(도구 4 + 스킬 1 + 배선) + R-Phase8(품질 강화 4 + probe funnel) 추가분을 미반영.

| 권한·안전 — glob matching (Cursor .mdc / Claude paths: 흡수) | ReDoS-hardened glob DP matcher (skill activation + Cursor rule paths) | **L4** | Memoized dynamic-programming glob matcher for the constructs Claude Code's `paths:` and Cursor `.cursor/rules` `globs:` use: `**` (any chars incl. `/`, with an optional following `/` convenience), `*` (any run of non-`/`), `?` (one non-`/`), literals. A pattern without a `/` matches a path's basename at any depth (gitignore semantics). NOT regex by design: glob patterns come from attacker-influenceable frontmatter, and the obvious `**`→`.*` translation produces multiple unbounded `.*` quantifiers — a pattern like `**/x/**/x/**/x` compiles to `.*x/.*x/.*x` and catastrophically backtracks (O(nᵏ)) on a long NON-matching path, hanging the whole agent (DoS). JS lacks atomic groups / possessive quantifiers, so the matcher uses a memoized DP instead: every (token, position) pair is decided at most once → hard O(tokens · len²) ceiling with no exponential blowup. Hard caps on inputs: `MAX_GLOB_LEN = 4096`, `MAX_PATH_LEN = 8192`, combined work-budget `MAX_GLOB_WORK = 1 << 20` (tokens × len product). Over-cap inputs short-circuit to no-match (safe failure mode — a malicious oversized glob/path simply never matches). Used by skill activation (paths trigger) and Cursor rule path-matching. · src/skill/activation.ts · 3u/1i |

Distinct from L2 long-term memory: working memory is never persisted to a store and is dropped on session end. Generic over the message shape (`WorkingMemory<M>`) so the agent layer can bind it to the full @/llm `Message` type while the memory slice stays free of an @/llm import — the llm `Message` is structurally assignable to the slice's minimal `StoredMessage` shape. In STRICT mode (eval) the first failure rethrows so the caller can mark the instance verdict `degraded`. No IO, deterministic. The `degraded()` snapshot returns one record per port+reason with hit count, so a recorder/probe can render "TeeStream: port-2 EPIPE x37". TeeStream itself NEVER writes trajectory — it only fans out + tracks; the recorder is responsible for translating degraded records into the trajectory `observability_degraded` event. Pairs with: `tee` is the multi-surface seam — a host wires `[StdoutStream, JsonlRecorder, SseStream]` behind a single TeeStream and the agent loop emits events into one port. Consumers that ignore phase observe byte-identical behaviour. · src/llm/assemble.ts, src/llm/types.ts · ADR-76,77 · 3u |

Lever propagation: the 12-lever discriminated union from `ModePolicy` translates HERE to concrete `AgentConfig` fields. New levers added to `ModePolicy` MUST be wired here AND in `apps/agent/mode-presets/<mode> .ts` — the per-mode preset owns lever→implementation mapping; this file owns the unified type-narrow + BudgetMeter construction + exhaustion policy plumbing. Default-OFF / byte-identical: callers may pass `modePolicy: undefined` to skip the whole RFC may-22 layer — the returned config is byte-identical to a pre-RFC manually-assembled `AgentConfig` (no budgetMeter, no modePolicy). Bench CLI 로직을 duplicate하지 않고 (`bench/index.ts` 직접 import 안 함) 같은 dataset path를 reading하는 방식. `BenchMapping` 테이블이 "벤치 X → UseCaseId Y" 매핑을 declarative하게 보유 (SWE-bench Verified → primary `software-quality.debugging.error-message-paste` + secondary 3개; LiveCodeBench/TerminalBench/Multi-SWEbench 각각 별도 leaf). 매핑이 missing 이면 fail-loud throw — wired adapter인데 taxonomy mapping 없으면 records가 hardcoded default로 silent landing 위험. report 파일이 없으면 warn record 하나만 남기고 빈 run (operator가 `bun run bench` 먼저 돌리라는 명시 신호). full direct-spawn (bench CLI 우회)은 RFC-0003 §5 next step. · src/apps/eval/public/adapters/swebench.ts, src/apps/eval/public/mapping.ts |
| eval 앱 — Tier 4 A/B 판정 | eval Tier 4 — pairwise judge with bias-swap double pass | **L4** | Tier 4 compare의 채점기 — 두 transcript + scenario rubric → ONE winner (또는 tie). BIAS MITIGATION (standard): judge를 두 번 호출 (forward + swapped) → swap 후 "A"가 "B"가 되어야 같은 winner가 inverse로 reported. 두 verdict가 inverse-consistent해야 winner counted; 아니면 tie. Position bias 표준 완화. 내부 `RawVerdict`가 `{kind:"winner"}` vs `{kind:"parse_failed", reason}`를 명시적으로 구분 — silent conflation 금지 (overloaded provider → garbage → "tie" → 경합으로 보이는 false signal 차단). 단일 JSON object output으로 parser는 small + defensive. LLM이 garbage 반환하면 `parseFailed:true + winnerIndex:-1`로 inconclusive 기록 (tie와 별도). `winnerIndex`는 original participants 리스트의 index (-1 = tie). `note`는 forward pass의 short rationale로 운영자가 PR 댓글에서 즉시 가독. · src/apps/eval/compare/pairwise-judge.ts, src/apps/eval/compare/adapter.ts · 1u |
| ChatGPT-OAuth provider (ADR-0094 Phase 1) | RefreshCoordinator (ChatGPT-OAuth thundering-herd guard) | **L4** | Coordinates concurrent refresh_token exchanges so multiple callers sharing the same (issuer, clientId, refresh_token) tuple await one in-flight Promise instead of racing two requests at the issuer (Codex doesn't guard this — we do). Extracted from a module-level Map into a named class so per-adapter isolation (e.g. Phase-2 streaming adapter, parallel test harness) is possible without bleeding state through the module-level singleton. Inflight slot is freed in `.finally()` on both resolve and reject paths so the Map stays memory-clean. Process-wide default (`defaultCoordinator`) preserves byte-identical behavior for the historical `refreshToken(input)` callers. Test seams: `__reset()` + `__sizeForTest()` on the instance, and `__resetInflightForTest()` for the module-level default. · src/auth/chatgpt-oauth/refresh.ts · ADR-94 · 1u |
| Surface-agnostic UI helpers (ANSI / box-drawing) | ColorPolicyResolver (per-surface ANSI color cache) | **L4** | Encapsulates the ANSI color-policy cache so multiple surfaces (CLI, REPL, Tauri renderer, parallel test harness) can keep isolated state instead of sharing one module-level cell. Resolution order on first use: 1. Explicit override via `set(mode)` (test seam). 2. `NO_COLOR` env present (https://no-color.org) → off. 3. `FORCE_COLOR=1` → on. 4. `process.stdout.isTTY` truthy → on, else off. The decision is cached so color state doesn't oscillate within one render. Module-level `setColorPolicy(mode)` + `wrap()` continue to operate against `defaultResolver` (byte-identical to pre-refactor); new callers that need isolation construct their own resolver. · src/ui/ui-helpers.ts · ADR-59,94 · 1u · ⚙️NO_COLOR, FORCE_COLOR |
| Shadow ODB rewind primitive (ADR-0118) | Shadow ODB rewindToLast — destructive restore + auto safety net | **L4** | Closes the deliberate "not-implemented" trap from ADR-0108 by implementing rewindToLast (destructive workspace restore to last snapshot) plus a safety net: before rewind, the current workspace state is captured under a pre-rewind ref so the user can recover from accidental rewind. Adds RewindOptions / SnapshotMetadata types, listSnapshots inspector, and typed error codes (merge-in-progress, rewind-failed). Refuses to rewind across an in-progress merge. · src/storage/shadow-odb/types.ts, src/storage/shadow-odb/default.ts · ADR-118 |
| Shadow ODB anchor policy (ADR-0121) | Shadow ODB auto-checkpoint policy | **L4** | Policy module that decides when the Shadow ODB should auto-register a head snapshot without an explicit caller. Closed enum of trigger conditions, a DI oracle (so policy is testable without real storage), per-(workspace, turn) dedup so multi-tool turns produce a single checkpoint, and a withAutoCheckpoint wrap helper that turns any action into a checkpointed action. Composition- root wiring helper exposes the policy default-OFF so unwired hosts remain byte-identical. · src/agent/checkpoint-policy.ts, src/agent/checkpoint-wiring.ts · ADR-121 |
| surface-agnostic session ops | runner/session-ops — surface-agnostic `quanta session …` dispatcher | **L4** | `quanta session <subcommand>` 의 dispatcher 를 surface-agnostic 슬라이스로 격리. 8 개 서브커맨드 (`list` / `show` / `delete` / `rename` / `archive` / `unarchive` / `fork` / `import`) 를 단일 진입점 `runSessionCommand(argv, deps)` 으로 분기. argv 가 `session` 으로 시작하지 않으면 본 모듈은 ZERO 실행 — REPL / agent 경로로 fall-through (byte-identical default-OFF posture). Pure-ish 설계: 모든 stdout/stderr 가 주입된 `out`/`err` writer 로 라우팅, interactive confirm 도 `confirm: (prompt) => Promise<boolean>` 로 주입 → binary spawn / readline attach 없이 unit test 가능. 함수가 numeric exit code (`0` 성공 / `1` 에러) 를 반환 — caller (`apps/cli/index.ts`) 가 `process.exit(...)` 로 매핑. Surface-agnostic seam (`SessionCommandDeps`): - `out` / `err` — io writer port (surface 가 stdout/HTTP/IPC 선택) - `confirm` — interactive yes/no port (test mockable) - `homeDir` — external-agent install scan root (test injectable) - `importHandler` — `@/migration` 진입점을 surface 가 와이어링 (`@/runner` 슬라이스가 `@/migration` 을 직접 import 금지 — biome 규칙). 미세트 ⇒ `import` 서브커맨드 fail-fast (silent skip 방지) - `listEnv` — `SessionListEnv` (defaultFormat / defaultMaxN); surface 가 TTY 감지 결과 등을 typed 으로 주입 `list-tui.ts` 가 rich (TUI 컬러/박스) vs plain (파이프/리다이렉트/테스트) 렌더링 분기 + 정렬·필터 파이프라인 (`applyListPipeline` / `buildSessionListEntries` / `renderSessionList`) 담당. · src/runner/session-ops/index.ts, src/runner/session-ops/list-tui.ts · 1u |
| Shadow ODB verify advance (ADR-0123) | Verify-checkpoint bridge — opt-in markVerified caller seam | **L3** | Caller seam that lets verify-pass events advance the Shadow ODB markVerified ref. Keeps mechanism (markVerified port from ADR-0122) and policy (when to call) separate so verify-guard can wire when its in-flight edits land. - **CLI turn-summary box — tools/verify-guard/compaction/memory/recovery** (L4) — 의도적 미노출: redacted 값 본문, memory recall score, turn timing 세부
breakdown (TTFT trio는 별도 trace 채널). score는 score-gaming invariant. → verbose mode (`QUANTA_TURN_SUMMARY_VERBOSE=1`)에서 추가 메트릭 노출
검토 — 단 redacted 본문/score는 영구 hide.
- **CLI `/help` unified menu — dynamic BUILTINS + keybinds + ENV knobs** (L4) — `/exit` + `/quit`은 `runReplLoop`에서 BUILTINS 진입 *전*에 short-circuit
되므로 BUILTINS에는 없지만 사용자는 `/help`에서 보길 기대 — 현재 수동
"virtual tail" 로 잡고 있다. 다른 short-circuit 명령이 늘면 동기화 부담. → short-circuit 명령도 SlashCommand 인터페이스로 1차 등록 후
`executeImmediately: true` 메타로 분기 → virtual tail 제거.
- **CLI `/help` discovery — category grouping + env-var SSOT + virtual /image** (L4) — short-circuit 가상 명령 (`/exit` / `/quit` / `/image`) 은 SlashCommand
인터페이스에 등록되지 않아 BUILTINS 와의 single-source-of-truth 가
아님. `VIRTUAL_COMMANDS` 수동 list 가 drift 위험. → short-circuit 명령도 SlashCommand 로 등록 + `executeImmediately: true`
메타 분기 ⇒ VIRTUAL_COMMANDS 제거.
- **CLI status-bar — DECSTBM scroll-region pinned bottom row** (L4) — No dedicated unit test yet — the module is currently exercised only
indirectly via REPL smoke. ANSI sequences + DECSTBM lifecycle would
benefit from a string-sink unit test that asserts the exact escape
bytes around paint / overlay-revert / teardown. → Add `tests/unit/cli/status-bar.test.ts` driving a fake writer through
create → paint → transient → revert → teardown and asserting exact ANSI
bytes.
- **/snapshot — Shadow-ODB snapshot list / rewind / partial restore** (L4) — No standalone snapshot-cmd unit test yet; coverage is via the broader
`shadow-odb-rewind-extensions-hellgate.test.ts` and `shadow-odb-hellgate
.test.ts` (tool-body level). The pure helpers (`parseSnapshotArgs`,
`renderSnapshotList`, `pickByOrdinal`) are unit-testable in isolation

pickByOrdinal + dispatch with a stub ShadowOdb port; sample bad-ordinal

- **probe — plain-text renderers (`--failed` / `--slow` / `--cost` / `--json`)** (L4) — Renderer is currently covered only via the integration suite (rendered
string snapshot per view). Pure-function unit coverage of individual

## Codex 특정 의도적 미흡수 (ADR-0015~0023 근거)

- **Heartbeat/cron 자동화** (`codex_app.automation_update`) — CLI/bench는 single-session, 적용 부재
- **Plugin bundle** (skills + MCP + app capability 묶음 패키징) — skill 단독으로 커버, plugin 형식은 ROI 낮음
- **Cassette validator 엄격 per-entry 검증** — Codex 자체가 placeholder로 표기, 본 환경도 동일 보류
- **숨겨진 global memory DB** — Codex가 NON-CLAIM으로 표기. 본 환경은 명시적 `QUANTA_MEMORY_PATH` 영속만 사용
- **Git directive 5종** (`::git-stage`/`::git-commit` 등 UI 레일 명령) — CLI에 UI 레일 없음, `bash`/`git_*` 도구로 충분

## 의도적 미흡수 (제품/운영/실험 인프라 — ADR-0011 근거)

백그라운드 데몬 · Statsig 원격게이트/kill-switch · Datadog+cohort 텔레메트리 · full speculative-prompt-execution

> 이전 라운드에서 보류했던 항목(예: `update_working_state` per-string 캡 / empty-patch refine / `ToolResult.evidence` 평면화 / HARD_DENY rule 명명화 / `inferToolTier` secure-by-default / `MUTATING_MODES` 인버스 / `applyScriptedReplaceBounded` 회수 / 시스템 프롬프트 cargo prune)은 후속 라운드에서 해소되어 상기 features 표에 반영됨. 변동 이력은 git log 참조.
